title: Cross-modal Counterfactual Explanations: Uncovering Decision Factors and Dataset Biases in Subjective Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Generating text-based counterfactual explanations using a cross-modal decompositionality framework (DeX) and applying topic modeling (BERTopic) to cluster the explanations. This identifies the dominant visual concepts and themes (e.g., nudity/sexual content versus personal objects) driving the model's subjective privacy classifications, revealing content imbalances in the underlying datasets.
